{{Top|leg}}
'''Sensor buoys''' were information gathering devices used in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]<ref name="ZA">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref> and underwater.<ref name="WC">{{JournalCite|2|A World to Conquer}}</ref> The [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Zirtran's Anchor/Legends|Zirtran's Anchor]] employed a network of sensor buoys controlled by [[Defensus Solar]] as part of their early-warning system.<ref name="ZA" /> Sensory buoys were also employed by [[Leviathan Submersible Carrier]]s to track targets in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The Leviathan would release the buoy underwater and it would float to the surface, activating at a designated time. The buoy would scan for targets in orbit and collect the data. The Leviathan would then retrieve the buoy and process the information.<ref name="WC" />
